headline: High outlook for long outages in Harris County
summary: Homes in Harris County lose power for 12 hours or more about once every 4 years. That comes from 8 years of records since 2018. The largest outage here began on July 8, 2024. At its peak, 91% of homes in the county were dark. For a home with electric heat, one Core lasts about 17 hours in August and about 38 hours in March. We suggest two Cores. That would have covered 64% of past long outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
